producer_report.summary: Added Priority::Urgent (sorts before High) and Priority::parse. Added a new append-only record `athena.priority/1` at `<job>/priority-<n>.json` (level, why, time; the highest n wins), loaded into JobRecords. Added `athena priority <job> <level> --why ...` (Athena::set_priority). It refuses an unknown level, an unknown job, a missing --why and any job not queued, and writes nothing then. `reading::job_priority` gives the newest record, else urgent if the latest reading has an urgent_reason, else the Priority: line. plan_entry and status::job_line both use it, so plan, drain and status agree. The reader now has a required nullable `urgent_reason` output; the urgent rule is its doc in outputs.rs, and reader.md is untouched. The Reading record gains an optional `urgent_reason` that old records parse without. Tests were added for ordering, the override through the real command, the reading, the schema and the record. CHANGELOG.md, docs/decisions.md (D122) and docs/records.md are updated.

open_issues: Departure from the plan: the CLI-level tests are in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs, not a new priority.rs, because they reuse that file's RealSteps, StubPage and RecordingLander helpers.
Departure: the status check goes through Athena::status() (StatusView.open[].priority), not a rendered line.
No test runs the `athena priority` clap command through the binary; the tests call Athena::set_priority, which the command calls. The help text is checked only by reading it.
The Priority command doc and the `drain` help were changed in main.rs; no test asserts on their wording.
reader.md was not edited (it is a listed deliverable but is at its budget).
Not measured: how many tokens the new urgent_reason schema field adds to a real reading call.
mistakes: First wrote the reading test calling a nonexistent status helper and a closure that borrowed the job; fixed both before the run.
The first version of the refusal test used a request that the plan did not read, so it was still queued; fixed by using an incomplete request.
learnings: ReadingOutput fields of type Option are accepted missing by serde even under deny_unknown_fields, so old fixtures parse; the schema hardening only matters for real model runs.
JobRecords.add silently ignores unknown record kinds, so a new record kind needs a field and an arm in store.rs.
Schema descriptions from multi-line doc comments keep newlines, so tests should normalise whitespace.
A plan reads (and so un-queues) only requests whose own words leave the plan incomplete; requests with a bullet and a known path stay queued under drain::plan.
desires: A way to run `cargo fmt --all --check` separately from applying it, and `git diff --stat` for untracked files.
